full_judgment: The plaintiff opposite party on 12.11.89 instituted Title Suit No. 385 of 1989 against the petitioner No. 1 and his wife and others for declaration of plaintiff's title in eight katha of land and for recovery of khas possession of 1/2 katha of land from the defendant petitioner Nos.1 and 2 and another. Thereafter defendant petitioners 1 and 2 filed their joint written statement on 7.5.90. The suit was taken up for hearing on 18.9.91 and the plaintiff opposite party No. 1 was examined and cross-examined partly by the defendant petitioners. During the cross-examination PW 1 the plaintiff stated that ১/২ কাঠা জমিতে আমি দখলে নাই। ১৯৮৭ পর্যন্ত ৮ কাঠা দখলে ছিল, তবে ১/২ কাঠার খাজনা দিতেছি। কিন্তু ১/২ কাঠা দখল এখন আই। ড্রেইন এর জন্য ১৯৮৭ সালে ১/২ কাঠা নিয়া যায় ঐ ৯ শরীক।”
